sections.kicker: Prepared for Ora by Atla · November 2026
sections.lead: We looked at your site and your Instagram the way a new customer would. Here is what stood out, in order of weight.
sections.thesis: Ora's best line is on Instagram. The site says something softer.
sections.keep: "Made properly, or not at all." It is a standard you can hold every product to.

sections.label: Front door
title: Three things people
meet first.
Three things
people meet
first.

pins.quote: Made properly, or not at all.
pins.what: This line is a position: a standard, stated plainly.
pins.why: It answers why Ora and not the next supplement shelf, and the site never says it.
pins.how: Make it the line the site opens with.
pins.label: Your bio
pins.cost: Shoppers compare tubs on price, because the site gives no other reason.

pins.quote: Drawing on the wisdom of Ayurveda, Traditional Chinese Medicine, Functional Naturopathic Medicine and the latest clinical science
pins.what: The about names four traditions at once.
pins.why: Covering everything makes the position harder to hold, next to a bio that says evidence based.
pins.how: Pick the frame you want to be known for and let the others support it.
pins.label: Your about
pins.cost: People cannot repeat what Ora stands for.

pins.what: The site says Ora Health; the handle says The Ora Standard.
pins.why: Two names split the memory, and the stronger one is not on the site.
pins.how: Choose the name that carries the standard.
pins.label: Your name
pins.cost: Every mention builds two brands at half strength each.

sections.intro: You said positioning is what bothers you. Your Instagram already has a position. The site has not caught up.

sections.body: It is 20 minutes with me. We go through this page together, on Ora's own screens, and you leave knowing what to change first.
sections.note: A few short questions first, then you pick a time. You can also just reply to the email.

reference: Patagonia, from another category. It made one standard the reason to buy.
